subject: Signal and System
questionText:
Which of the following statement is not true?
 (a)
The product of two even function is even.
(b)
The product of two odd function is even.
(c)
The product of an even and odd function is
neither even nor odd.
(d)
The product of an even and odd function is odd

options.text: The product of two even function is even.
The product of two odd function is even.
The product of an even and odd function is
The product of an even and odd function is odd

explanation: Practice Question from Signal and System DPP-05 (Signal and Systems).
